reviewPassage:
TO: Teams using the materials lab
SUBJECT: Booking the vibration table while the calendar is down

Until the calendar is back, sign up on the board beside the lab door. Write your team's name and the cabinet number for the test pieces. The technician will use that number to locate the pieces before your session begins; the table must be clear when she brings them in.

If you cancel, cross out only your own line. Do not erase the whole line: the technician uses the crossed-out cabinet number to check where to put the pieces back. Keep that number legible even though the booking has been canceled. Once the pieces are back in the cabinet, she will place a small check mark next to the crossed-out number. A check mark on its own does not mean a time slot is available. Look for an empty time row before signing up.
reviewPassageZh:
收件人：使用材料實驗室的團隊
主旨：日曆系統停用期間如何預約振動台

日曆系統恢復前，請在實驗室門旁的板子上登記。寫上團隊名稱與存放測試件的櫃號。技術員會在你的測試開始前用櫃號找到測試件；她把測試件帶進來時，台面必須是空的。

如果取消，只要把自己的那一行劃掉。不要把整行擦掉：技術員會用被劃掉的櫃號確認要把測試件放回哪裡。即使已取消預約，也要確保櫃號仍看得清楚。測試件放回櫃子後，技術員會在劃掉的櫃號旁打一個小勾。單憑打勾並不表示該時段可以預約。登記前請先找沒有填寫的時段列。
